label: RESEARCH PREVIEW - not a production showcase. Rendered by the upstream PlayCanvas engine in the ifc-lite research spike, not by the ifc-lite viewer.

rebase.identity: git blob equality for showcase.html, showcase.mjs, showcase-framing.mjs, showcase-credits.mjs, demo-camera.mjs, capture.mjs, record-showcase.mjs, vite.config.mjs, prepare.mjs, package.json, finish-showcase.mjs, pnpm-lock.yaml and tests/models/manifest.json; main only added unrelated #8616 fragment-interval files

asset.verified: Node SHA-256 before serving and browser crypto.subtle SHA-256 of the exact fetched bytes; decoded row count equals manifest count

license.credit: Seem Kirke, Danmark — Peter Rødsgaard Rasmussen (roedsgaard) · CC BY 4.0 · superspl.at/scene/e832997f
license.change: Published quantized SOG converted to PLY; viewpoint changed · creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0

camera.path: examples/gaussian-splat-spike/demo-camera.mjs demoCameraAt(wall-clock seconds), 30 s, 55 degree vertical FOV, smoothstep keys 0-3 hold, 3-15 orbit 110 deg, 15-22 approach to 1.65 radii, 22-27 pull back to 155 deg, 27-30 hold
camera.displayRotation: x180 (source Y-down training frame to viewer Y-up; proper rotation, no scale)

framingAuto.method: opacity>0.5 percentiles p2-p98, half box diagonal; rotation x180

camera.framingNote: Center = automatic robust opaque-splat box center. Radius 19.5 chosen over automatic 23.40 after a stills check along the journey so the church fills more of the frame; the closest approach stays outside the churchyard capture. Units are reconstruction units, not metres.

capture.method: canvas.captureStream() (every painted frame) + MediaRecorder; camera from demoCameraAt(wall-clock seconds) inside the PlayCanvas update loop
capture.videoTimestamps: 904 frames; one 199 ms gap at 0.333 s inside the static 0-3 s opening hold (identical view); all motion at ~33 ms

finishing.method: ffmpeg drawtext over the untouched master; -fps_mode passthrough with the demuxer time base keeps capture timestamps
finishing.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.0.1-3ubuntu2 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
finishing.timestampCheck: master, MP4 and WebM frame timestamp lists identical (904 frames)
finishing.colour: full-range BT.709 capture mapped to limited range for compatibility; luma mean 46.0 vs 46.5 against direct renderer readback at t=0 (PSNR 34.2 dB through two lossy generations)

rejectedTake.reason: captureStream(30) rate limiting dropped 107 of 909 engine frames (66 ms judder through motion)

notQualified: integrated ifc-lite viewer and useIfcLoader.loadFile ingestion
ifc-lite renderer, mixed IFC/splat composition, clipping, picking, removal
performance, frame budgets, memory or device limits (timings are diagnostics of one take)
metric scale, georeference or IFC alignment (no IFC overlay)
higher-order SH appearance (published SH coefficients are zero)
